UIGestureRecognizerStatePossible.description: Initial resting state. Touch points and initial timestamps are acquired into historical ring buffer. Gesture evaluates cumulative displacement against device-specific touch slop threshold without mutating viewport contentOffset.

UIGestureRecognizerStateBegan.description: Gesture recognition threshold satisfied (displacement >= touchSlop or momentum interruption bypass). Subview content touches cancelled. UIScrollView flags updated (isDragging = 1), delegate notified via scrollViewWillBeginDragging:.

UIGestureRecognizerStateChanged.description: Continuous interactive drag state. Touch translation updates viewport content offset on every input event (120Hz/60Hz). Directional lock clamping applied if active. Rubber-band resistance evaluated when overshooting viewport bounds.

UIGestureRecognizerStateEnded.description: Normal terminal state. All active touches lifted from display. Release velocity evaluated from ring buffer. Projected rest offset computed, delegate notified via scrollViewWillEndDragging:withVelocity:targetContentOffset:.

UIGestureRecognizerStateCancelled.description: Interrupted terminal state. Gesture tracking aborted by external interruption (incoming telephone call, notification center pull, system modal presentation, or competitor gesture recognizer takeover). Drag state cleared without momentum fling.

UIGestureRecognizerStateFailed.description: Failure terminal state. Touch sequence terminated before satisfying recognition criteria (e.g., finger lifted before reaching touch slop, gestureRecognizerShouldBegin: returned NO, or directional lock blocked active scroll axis).

touchesBegan:withEvent:.description: Initial digitizer contact packet dispatched by UIWindow hit-test hierarchy. Caches initial touch location, seeds velocity ring buffer, and arms touch delay timers.

touchesMoved:withEvent:.description: Dispatched on continuous coordinate updates. Accumulates displacement vector, executes touch slop discrimination, applies directional locking, and updates contentOffset.

touchesEnded:withEvent:.description: Dispatched when final active touch contact leaves display surface. Samples historical velocity ring buffer, resolves ballistic fling launch, or triggers spring rebound.

touchesCancelled:withEvent:.description: Dispatched when hardware touch delivery is invalidated by system-level modal takeover or parent gesture preemption. Restores bounds origin without ballistic fling.

_touchDelayTimerFired.description: Dispatched after 150ms timeout by UIScrollViewDelayedTouchesBeganGestureRecognizer. Delivers deferred touchesBegan to interactive content subviews if slop is not yet crossed.

_forcePanGestureToEndImmediately.description: Programmatic override routine forcing active tracking recognizer directly into Ended or Cancelled state (e.g. on setContentOffset:animated: or user interaction disabling).

reset.description: Internal lifecycle cleanup executed upon transitioning to terminal states (Ended, Cancelled, Failed). Flushes velocity ring buffer, resets directional lock, and returns to Possible.

_updateGestureState.description: Internal state coordinator invoked during touch tracking to test slop thresholds, check directional lock constraints, consult delegate admissibility, and mutate the FSM state.

decompiled_routines.summary: Inspects deceleration state of parent UIScrollView (_scrollView at ivar +0x80). If isDecelerating == 1, terminates CADisplayLink and triggers immediate ballistic handoff into Began state. Otherwise, stores touch coordinate and schedules 150ms subview delay timer.

Evaluates cumulative translation. Distinguishes touch device types (finger 10pt, pencil 4pt, trackpad 2pt). When threshold is exceeded, verifies _gestureRecognizerShouldBegin: and directional lock. Cancels subview touches and dispatches handlePan:.

Samples the rolling velocity ring buffer, calculates release velocity vector in viewport coordinates, transitions state to Ended (3), and passes final motion metrics to UIScrollView momentum animation launcher.
Handles external input cancellation. Mutates state to Cancelled (4), clears active dragging flags, and triggers spring snap-back if viewport is rested in rubber-band zone.

Central UIScrollView gesture action target. Routes Began, Changed, Ended, and Cancelled states. Computes delta offsets, evaluates rubber-banding logarithmic dampening, mutates _contentOffset at +0x100, updates layer bounds origin, and broadcasts telemetry.

Pre-flight validation executed prior to gesture recognition. Verifies axis capabilities (_canScrollX, _canScrollY), verifies bounds vs contentSize limits, and consults delegate gestureRecognizerShouldBegin:.
Internal state coordinator evaluating hardware touch slop thresholds, directional locking constraints, delegate pre-flight vetoes, and triggering transition dispatches.
Sets isDragging = 1 in _scrollViewFlags (+0xd0) and dispatches scrollViewWillBeginDragging: delegate callback.
Halts active deceleration CADisplayLink timer, pins presentation layer origin to _contentOffset, flushes pending render frames, and clears isDecelerating flag.
CADisplayLink target tick handler integrating deceleration physics steps at 120Hz/60Hz; interrupted and detached immediately upon new touchesBegan: touch contact.
Arbitrates touch ownership between viewport scrolling and subviews; returns YES for UIButtons/generic views to cancel highlighting, returns NO for complex controls (sliders, switches).
Hit-tests touch coordinates against scroll indicator knob frames; defers to UIScrollViewKnobLongPressGestureRecognizer if touch lands on knob.
Configures concurrent gesture arbitration; permits simultaneous recognition with _UIScrollViewPinchGestureRecognizer and SwiftUI hosting bridges, enforces exclusivity against competing pans.
